title: Reliable fairness auditing with semi-supervised inference

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating group-specific disparities in model performance metrics (e.g., Accuracy, Brier score, NPV, PPV, TPR, FPR) between White and non-White patients using the proposed semi-supervised 'Infairness' framework to impute missing outcomes.
Evaluating group-specific disparities in model performance metrics between Male and Female patients using the proposed semi-supervised 'Infairness' framework to impute missing outcomes.
Evaluating group-specific disparities in model performance metrics between Married and non-Married patients using the proposed semi-supervised 'Infairness' framework to impute missing outcomes.

Evaluating group-specific disparities in model performance metrics based on insurance type (Medicare vs. non-Medicare) using the proposed semi-supervised 'Infairness' framework to impute missing outcomes.
